strings.subtitle: — Mwiminisi wa bafwelo —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Kubenta ye kubika kele ve. Sadila buto ya nsi.
strings.ft_lnk: Nzila ya nkufi (.lnk) — yi ta buya
strings.shred_button: M I N I N A
strings.ssd_warning:
Lukebisu! Na SSD, nzila ya kusonika na zulu ke lenda monisa ve kumiminwa sambu ya TRIM.
Programe yai kele ya HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Fwelo "{name}" yi ta sonikwa na zulu ye yi ta katulwa.

Kuluta?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_title: ✅  FWELO SONIKWA NA ZULU YE KATULWA
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS mizila ya nsangu ya nkaka (ADS) ke salwa ve.
• Mukanda wa USN ke kukumuswa ve.
• Bafwanisi ya kifu ye bamvwanga ya matuti
  (OneDrive ye bampila) ke kuswaswanwa ve.
strings.status_full: Mambu ya kati me sonikwa na zulu mpenza ye zelo. Kuvutuka ke lenda ve — bisadilu ta mona zelo mpamba.
strings.status_fast: Ntu, nkila ye mizila 4 MB me sonikwa na zulu. Yankaka ke simbwa ve, kansi sambu ya mpwasa, kuvutuka yawonsu na bisadilu ya bafwelo ya bantu ke lenda ve. Sambu ya mikanda ya kinsweki, sadila mutindu ya MVIDI.
strings.status_empty: Fwelo vwandaka mpamba, kusonika na zulu vandaka ve na mfunu. Katulwa.
strings.error_permission: Ke lenda kota na fwelo ve. Yo lenda vanda ya kukangulwa na programe ya nkaka. Kanga yo ye meka diaka.
strings.error_not_found: Fwelo me monanana ve. Yo lenda vanda ya katulwa.
strings.error_is_symlink: Yai kele kinkondwa ya kifwanisu. Bakinkondwa ke lenda mininwa ve — fwelo ya ntindu ta bikala mbote.
strings.error_reparse: Yai kele fwelo ya kisika (OneDrive to ya mutindu mosi). Bansangu na yo kele na matuti, ve na disiki — kele ve ti kima ya kuminina awa.
strings.error_not_file: Yai kele ve fwelo (fodolo to kima ya nkaka). Bika fwelo.
strings.error_hardlinks: Fwelo yai kele ti bankondwa ya ngolo ya nkaka ({n} yawonsu). Bankondwa ya ngolo kele ve ti mfumu — bankumbu yawonsu kele kiteso mosi. Kana kuminina na nzila ya ntangu yai, bansangu ta sonikwa na zulu ye ta zengwa na 32 byte, kansi ntini ta bikala ya kukota na bankondwa ya nkaka. Katula bankondwa yawonsu na ntangu ya ntete.
strings.error_compressed:
Fwelo me kangwa, me solwa to kele ya kukonda. Kusonika na zulu ye zelo ke monisa ve kumiminwa ya bansangu ya ntama sambu NTFS ke bumba yo na nzila ya nkaka.

Katula kidimbu: finya na lubaku ya kitata → Bimvuka → Ya ntete → katula kidimbu ya "Kanga" ye/to "Sola". Na nima, sala SHREDDER diaka.
